utility.notes: Daly City is a well-documented San Mateo County city, and San Mateo County is uniformly PG&E territory, consistent with PG&E service already established for other San Mateo County records this session.

value.name: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) - ECOplus (default)
value.notes: Daly City's City Council voted unanimously to join Peninsula Clean Energy (now WestLight Energy, following the July 2026 rebrand) in January 2016, per WestLight Energy's own community benefits summary for Daly City. San Mateo County's CCA program enrolls all county jurisdictions' customers by default (opt-out model), consistent with the default-enrollment pattern independently confirmed for other San Mateo County cities this session.

permit_authority.value: City of Daly City Building Division (Economic & Community Development)

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other PG&E-territory records in this dataset.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes Daly City/San Mateo County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other PG&E-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value: Contact the Building Division at 650-991-8061 (8am-5pm, Monday-Friday) to schedule inspections

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (residential roof-mounted PV, up to 38.4 kW AC, with or without paired ESS)
other_conditions: Residential energy storage systems paired with solar are eligible under the same 38.4kW AC size restriction
